stories.headline: At least 130 Nigerians seek repatriation from South Africa after protests, Abuja says
stories.summary: At least 130 Nigerian citizens in South Africa have requested to be repatriated to Nigeria due to protests targeting foreigners. Nigerian Foreign Minister Bianca Odumegwu-Ojukwu announced the planned repatriation, stating that the citizens have asked to be flown home. The decision comes after a new wave of anti-immigration protests in South Africa, prompting the Nigerian government to take action. The foreign minister summoned South Africa's top representative in Nigeria on Monday to discuss the situation. The repatriation effort aims to ensure the safety of Nigerian citizens in South Africa, who have been affected by the protests. The Nigerian government is working to facilitate the return of its citizens, with the foreign minister overseeing the repatriation process.

stories.headline: Ukraine pressures Russia as midnight ceasefire looms
stories.summary: Ukraine has announced a truce in response to Russia's demand for a ceasefire to coincide with its annual World War II Victory Day commemorations. The ceasefire is set to begin at midnight, with Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky confirming the move. Russia has threatened a "massive missile strike" on Kyiv if Ukraine violates the ceasefire. The truce is seen as a response to Russia's demand, with Ukraine piling pressure on Russia ahead of the Victory Day celebrations. The situation remains tense, with Russia's threat hanging over the Ukrainian capital. The ceasefire is intended to coincide with Russia's commemorations, which mark the country's victory in World War II. The truce is set to begin at 9pm Irish time, with the international community watching the situation closely. Ukraine's move is a strategic response to Russia's demands.

stories.headline: Fireworks Factory Explosion in China Kills at Least 26
stories.summary: An explosion at a fireworks factory in China's Hunan province has killed at least 26 people and left 61 wounded. The blast occurred in the city of Changsha, prompting the halting of all firework manufacturing near the site. President Xi Jinping has ordered a thorough investigation into the incident, according to state media. The explosion flattened buildings and sent towering clouds of smoke into the sky. Authorities have reported the casualties, with the death toll currently standing at 26 and the number of injured at 61. The incident has raised concerns about safety standards in China's firework industry, with all manufacturing in the area suspended pending the outcome of the investigation. State media continues to provide updates on the situation, with further details expected to emerge as the investigation progresses.

stories.headline: Brisbane woman charged over torture, neglect of young girl
stories.summary: A 40-year-old woman from Logan Reserve, Brisbane, has been charged with three counts of failing to supply necessaries and one count of torture. The charges relate to the alleged neglect and torture of a 10-year-old girl who was admitted to hospital on February 9 with critical malnutrition, dehydration, and significant untreated injuries. Police declared the child's home a crime scene and conducted extensive inquiries, leading to the woman's charges. The girl's condition prompted a thorough investigation, and the woman will face court over the allegations. The incident occurred in Logan Reserve, south of Brisbane, and the woman's charges are a result of the police's thorough investigation into the girl's hospitalization.

stories.headline: Apple Plans to Let Users Build Their Own Passes in iOS 27 Wallet App
stories.summary: Apple is introducing a "Create a Pass" feature in the iOS 27 Wallet app, allowing users to build and customize their own digital tickets and gift cards. This feature will enable users to take a QR code and generate a custom pass around it, useful for situations like gym memberships or concert tickets. The tool will come with three templates, making it easy for users to create digital versions of physical passes. This update will be the first time iPhone users can add barcodes to Wallet without needing a third-party tool. The new feature is expected to be part of the next major iPhone software update, iOS 27, marking a significant development in the adoption of PassKit technology after 14 years. The update will provide users with more flexibility and convenience in managing their digital passes.

stories.headline: Ask.com shutdown marks transition away from legacy search AI search disruption sunsets legacy directories
stories.summary: Ask.com, a 25-year-old search engine and question-and-answer service, shut down on May 1, 2026. The closure marks a significant shift away from legacy search operations, as users increasingly adopt zero-click AI discovery. Parent company IAC exited the search business, citing a broader strategic shift towards integrated AI-driven search. The move reflects a trend towards generative AI-powered search engines, repositioning AI agents as the future of web browsing. Ask.com, formerly known as Ask Jeeves, was one of the internet's early search engines, but its closure indicates a decline in legacy directories. The shutdown is seen as a stark indicator of the transition towards AI-driven search, with major players dominating the market. The end of Ask.com marks the end of an era for early dot-com search engines.

stories.headline: Toy Model Sheds Light on AI Learning Process Artificial intelligence systems based on neural networks — such as ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek or Gemini — are extraordinarily powerful, yet their
stories.summary: Artificial intelligence systems based on neural networks, such as ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSeek, have shown extraordinary power due to improvements in deep neural networks and large language models. These models, including generative AI applications like text-to-image and text-to-video models, have been rapidly advancing. Researchers are using "toy models" to study the fundamental mechanisms of neural networks in a controlled laboratory setting. A recent study published in the Journal of Statistical Mechanics: Theory and Experiment utilized a toy model to shed light on the AI learning process. This research aims to understand the underlying mechanisms of neural networks, which could lead to further advancements in AI technology, including models like DeepSeek, which has been making waves in the AI scene since its introduction. The study's findings could contribute to the development of more powerful and efficient AI systems.

stories.headline: WhatsApp to stop working on older iPhones and Android phones
stories.summary: WhatsApp will stop working on older iPhone and Android models. The change takes effect on May 5, affecting devices that cannot support the latest version of the app. Users with affected devices will no longer be able to send or receive messages, make calls, or access other WhatsApp features. To continue using WhatsApp, users must upgrade to a supported device or operating system. The list of affected models includes older iPhone and Android devices that do not meet the app's updated system requirements. Users can export their chat history before the change takes effect to transfer it to a new device, ensuring they do not lose their conversations. WhatsApp recommends checking the app's website for a list of supported devices and to plan for the transition.

stories.headline: Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami reportedly at disadvantage to LA Galaxy in race for Casemiro
stories.summary: Lionel Messi's Inter Miami is reportedly at a disadvantage in the race to sign Brazilian midfielder Casemiro. The LA Galaxy is said to hold a significant advantage in securing Casemiro's signature. This development puts Messi's hopes of seeing Casemiro in an Inter Miami kit in jeopardy. Casemiro, a highly skilled player, would be a valuable addition to any team. The LA Galaxy's advantage is likely due to various factors, including financial and logistical considerations. Inter Miami will need to reassess their strategy if they want to stay in the running for Casemiro's services. The outcome of this transfer saga remains uncertain, with both teams vying for the Brazilian's attention. Casemiro's decision will be closely watched by fans and pundits alike.

stories.headline: ‘95 off 30 balls!’: Langer cites practice blitz to back ‘selfless’ Pant despite LSG defeat
stories.summary: Lucknow Super Giants head coach Justin Langer has expressed support for captain Rishabh Pant despite the team's recent defeat. Langer cited a practice session where Pant scored 95 runs off 30 balls, demonstrating his batting ability. The coach described Pant as "selfless" and emphasized his importance to the team. Langer's comments come after another disappointing outing for the Lucknow Super Giants, but he remains confident in Pant's leadership and skills. The coach's backing suggests that Pant will continue to lead the team, with Langer focusing on improving overall team performance rather than making changes at the top. Langer's endorsement is a significant show of faith in Pant's abilities as a captain and batsman.

stories.headline: Fiji select England, France castaways
stories.summary: Fiji has named a 50-man squad for the upcoming Nations Championship matches in July, featuring several notable inclusions. The squad includes a former France back, who has switched allegiance to represent Fiji. Additionally, an ex-England loose forward has also been selected, bringing valuable experience to the team. The Nations Championship is a significant tournament, and Fiji's squad selection indicates their intent to compete strongly. The inclusion of players with international experience from top-tier nations like England and France is expected to bolster Fiji's chances in the competition. The final team will be trimmed down from the current 50-man squad ahead of the tournament.

stories.headline: ‘It’s a special occasion’: Latrell’s lifts 18-month media ban with shock press conference
stories.summary: Latrell Mitchell has lifted his 18-month media ban with a surprise press conference. The NRL player had avoided speaking to the media since 2021, but decided to address the press to discuss his career and personal life. Mitchell cited a desire to share his story and connect with fans as the reason for ending his media ban. The press conference was seen as a significant move, allowing Mitchell to speak publicly about his experiences and thoughts on the sport. The decision to lift the ban was reportedly made by Mitchell himself, marking a new chapter in his public persona and relationship with the media. The move is expected to provide fans and the public with greater insight into Mitchell's life and career as a professional athlete.

stories.headline: Asansol Durga temple, shut for several years, reopens after BJP's huge Bengal win
stories.summary: A Durga temple in Asansol, West Bengal, has reopened after being shut for several years due to local tensions. The temple's reopening follows the BJP's significant win in Paschim Bardhaman district and the Assembly polls. The BJP's sweep in the region is seen as a factor in the decision to reopen the temple, which had been closed for an extended period. The temple is now accessible to devotees, marking a significant development in the area. The reopening is a result of changed circumstances in the region, with the BJP's victory being a key factor in the decision to allow the temple to resume its activities. Devotees can now visit the temple, which had been inaccessible for several years.

stories.headline: Goons entered, beat me up: Mamata's explosive phone call on Bhabanipur loss
stories.summary: Mamata Banerjee alleged that the Bhabanipur election result was stolen in a phone call posted by Kalyan Banerjee. She claimed that goons entered the counting center and beat her up, compromising the counting process. Banerjee stated that the result would be challenged legally, indicating her intention to contest the outcome. The phone call suggests that Banerjee believes the election was not conducted fairly and that she was physically harmed during the process. The authenticity of the call has not been disputed, and it appears to reflect Banerjee's strong objections to the election result. The legal challenge is expected to follow, with Banerjee seeking to overturn the outcome of the Bhabanipur election. The incident has sparked controversy and raised questions about the integrity of the election process.

stories.headline: TMC claims BJP behind arson attack on Siliguri office, shares video
stories.summary: The Trinamool Congress (TMC) has accused the BJP of being behind an arson attack on its office in Siliguri, West Bengal. The TMC shared a video of the incident, alleging that the BJP had "crossed all limits". This comes after the BJP's significant win in the West Bengal polls, where the TMC was reduced to around 80 seats. The incident is part of a surge in post-poll violence in the state. The TMC has also alleged irregularities in the counting process, with Mamata Banerjee claiming that the result in Bhabanipur was stolen. The BJP's victory has been widely reported internationally, with many publications covering the story. The Left front and Congress have also suffered significant losses in the polls, with the CPI(M) winning its lowest number of seats since 2001.

stories.headline: Post-Poll Fury: TMC Blames BJP For Arson & Vandalism At Siliguri Office, Says 'True Face Exposed'
stories.summary: Violence erupted in Siliguri as the Trinamool Congress (TMC) office was targeted by arson and vandalism. The TMC has blamed the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) for the incident, stating that it exposes the party's "true face." The surge in violence follows the recent election results, which saw a dramatic reversal of fortunes for Mamata Banerjee and the TMC. The party's seat count was reduced to around 80, and Banerjee suffered a personal blow by losing her Bhabanipur constituency to Suvendu Adhikari by over 15,000 votes. The TMC has accused the BJP of orchestrating the violence, claiming it is a desperate attempt to intimidate and silence their opponents. The incident has raised concerns about the escalating tensions and potential for further violence in the region. An investigation into the incident is likely to be launched.

stories.headline: Stocks hit as oil rallies on escalating geopolitics - Newsquawk US Market Wrap ZeroHedge
stories.summary: Stocks declined as oil prices rallied due to escalating geopolitical tensions. The US initiated a tariff surge on EU cars, with the US Trade Representative confirming President Trump's decision to increase EU car import tariffs to 25%. This move aims to pressure the EU on compliance issues. The tariff hike has contributed to rising tensions between the US and EU. As a result, oil prices have increased, impacting the stock market. The combination of geopolitical uncertainty and trade tensions has led to a decline in stocks, with investors becoming increasingly cautious. The situation is being closely monitored, with further developments expected to influence market trends. The US-EU trade relations continue to deteriorate, sparking concerns about the potential impact on the global economy.

stories.headline: U.S. Initiates Tariff Surge on EU Cars Amid Rising Tensions U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer confirmed President Trump’s decision to increase EU car import tariffs to 25%.
stories.summary: The US has initiated a tariff surge on EU cars, with the US Trade Representative confirming President Trump's decision to increase import tariffs to 25%. This move aims to pressure the EU on compliance with trade agreements. The decision has contributed to rising tensions between the US and EU, with stocks being affected and oil prices rallying due to escalating geopolitics. The increased tariffs will impact EU car manufacturers exporting to the US, potentially disrupting the global automotive market. The US Trade Representative, Jamieson Greer, confirmed the decision, which is part of the ongoing trade negotiations between the US and EU. The tariffs are expected to have significant economic implications, affecting trade relations and the automotive industry on both sides of the Atlantic. The EU is likely to respond to the tariffs, potentially escalating the trade dispute.

stories.headline: US and China Trade Tensions Intensify as Beijing Imposes Retaliatory Tariffs
stories.summary: The US and China trade tensions have intensified as Beijing imposed retaliatory tariffs. The move comes after the US initiated a tariff surge on EU cars, with the US Trade Representative confirming President Trump's decision to increase EU car import tariffs to 25%. This aims to pressure the EU on compliance. The escalating trade tensions have affected global markets, with stocks declining and oil prices rallying due to rising geopolitics. The US-China trade dispute has led to a series of retaliatory measures, with China imposing its own tariffs in response to US actions. The situation is being closely monitored, with potential implications for global trade and economic stability. The US has also been involved in trade disputes with the EU, further complicating international trade relations.

stories.headline: NATO Allies Gather for Emergency Meeting Amid Escalating Geopolitical Crisis
stories.summary: NATO allies have gathered for an emergency meeting amid an escalating geopolitical crisis. The meeting comes as tensions between the US and EU continue to rise, with the US initiating a tariff surge on EU cars. The US Trade Representative confirmed President Trump's decision to increase EU car import tariffs to 25%, aiming to pressure the EU on compliance. This move has contributed to a rally in oil prices, which has in turn affected the stock market. The escalating tensions have sparked concerns about the impact on global trade and economies. The emergency NATO meeting is expected to address the growing crisis and its implications for global stability. The situation is being closely monitored as it continues to unfold, with potential far-reaching consequences for international relations and the global economy.

stories.headline: BJP ends Mamata's 15-year West Bengal rule
stories.summary: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has ended Mamata Banerjee's 15-year rule in West Bengal. This significant political shift occurred after the BJP secured a majority in the state's recent elections. Mamata Banerjee, the leader of the All India Trinamool Congress (TMC), had been in power since 2011. The BJP's victory marks a major gain for the party in the eastern state. The election results have significant implications for Indian politics, with the BJP expanding its presence in the region. The change in government is expected to bring about new policies and developments in West Bengal, with the BJP aiming to implement its agenda in the state. The outcome of the election has been closely watched, given West Bengal's strategic importance in Indian politics.

stories.headline: KOSPI hits record 6,936.99
stories.summary: The KOSPI, South Korea's benchmark stock index, reached a record high of 6,936.99. This milestone comes as part of the Asia Pulse for May 4, 2026, which also saw significant developments in other regions. In India, the BJP ended Mamata Banerjee's 15-year rule in West Bengal. Meanwhile, former US President Donald Trump unveiled his Project Freedom Hormuz plan. Additionally, Russia and North Korea signed a pact, further shifting the geopolitical landscape. These events underscore the dynamic nature of global politics and economies, with the KOSPI's record high reflecting South Korea's strong market performance amidst international developments. The index's surge indicates investor confidence in the country's economic prospects.

stories.headline: Trump's Project Freedom Hormuz plan
stories.summary: Former US President Donald Trump has unveiled a plan called Project Freedom Hormuz, aiming to secure the strategic Strait of Hormuz. The project's details are not fully disclosed, but it is believed to be a strategy to ensure the free flow of oil and protect international shipping lanes in the region. The Strait of Hormuz is a critical waterway connecting the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman, with approximately 20% of the world's oil passing through it. Trump's plan comes amid ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. The announcement coincides with other significant developments in Asia, including the BJP's victory in West Bengal and a record-high KOSPI index in South Korea, as well as a reported pact between Russia and North Korea.

stories.headline: Russia-NK pact
stories.summary: Russia and North Korea have formed a pact, marking a significant development in their bilateral relations. The agreement comes as part of a broader geopolitical landscape, with other notable events unfolding in Asia. In India, the BJP has ended Mamata Banerjee's 15-year rule in West Bengal, while South Korea's KOSPI index has reached a record high of 6,936.99. Meanwhile, former US President Donald Trump has unveiled his Project Freedom Hormuz plan. The Russia-North Korea pact is the latest in a series of diplomatic maneuvers, with implications for regional and global stability. Details of the pact are still emerging, but it is expected to have significant consequences for international relations and security dynamics in the region. Further information is awaited as the situation continues to unfold.

stories.headline: Stock Markets Today: Sensex, Nifty50 Down on Strait of Hormuz Tensions, Weak Rupee
stories.summary: Indian equities experienced volatility, with the Sensex and Nifty50 declining due to tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and a weak rupee. The Strait of Hormuz tensions have led to global market uncertainty, impacting investor sentiment in India. The weak rupee has also contributed to the decline, as it affects the country's import costs and economy. As a result, the Sensex and Nifty50 saw a downturn, reflecting the cautious approach of investors. The movement of these key market indices is being closely tracked, with investors monitoring global trends and the rupee's performance. The decline in Indian equities is a reflection of the broader global market trends and the domestic economic factors at play. Investors are exercising caution, leading to the volatility in the Indian stock market.

stories.headline: Geopolitical Tensions, Rupee at Record Low Weigh on Market Sentiment
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty declined due to renewed geopolitical concerns. Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz and a strained US-Iran ceasefire have contributed to the market downturn. The Indian rupee has also reached a record low, further weighing on market sentiment. The decline in investor confidence is attributed to the escalating global tensions, which have raised concerns about oil price volatility and its potential impact on the Indian economy. As a result, foreign investors have become cautious, leading to a sell-off in the markets. The combination of geopolitical uncertainty and a weakening rupee has created a challenging environment for Indian stocks, leading to a decline in the Sensex and Nifty indices. The market is closely watching the developments in the Middle East and their potential implications for the global economy.

stories.headline: Stock Market Today: How Will Nifty 50, Sensex Trade On May 5?
stories.summary: Indian stock market indices, Nifty 50 and Sensex, are expected to open lower on May 5 due to weakness in global markets. The escalation of uncertainty in the US-Iran conflict has contributed to the decline. Trends on Gift Nifty indicate a gap-down opening for both Sensex and Nifty 50. Global market volatility is likely to impact the Indian market, causing it to open in the red. The US-Iran tensions have led to a decline in investor sentiment, resulting in a bearish trend in the market. As a result, traders and investors are advised to exercise caution, and market participants will be closely watching the developments in the US-Iran situation to gauge its impact on the Indian stock market. The opening trade is expected to be influenced by global cues and market sentiment.

stories.headline: Stock Market Live Updates: Which way are Sensex, Nifty headed? Oil prices rise on Hormuz disruptions, attack on UAE storage facility
stories.summary: Stock markets in India are expected to have a muted start on Tuesday, with GIFT Nifty signaling a slow opening for Sensex and Nifty. Rising oil prices may negatively impact market sentiment, as disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz and an attack on a UAE storage facility have led to an increase in oil prices. The attack on the storage facility has raised concerns about global oil supply, contributing to the price surge. As a result, investors are likely to exercise caution, potentially leading to a slow day for the Indian stock markets. The increase in oil prices may also have a ripple effect on various sectors, including those reliant on oil imports. Market participants will be closely watching the developments and their impact on the stock markets.

stories.headline: Japanese citrus farmers switch to avocados as climate change warms soil
stories.summary: Japanese citrus farmers are shifting to avocado cultivation due to rising soil temperatures caused by climate change. Traditionally, Japan's cooler regions were ideal for citrus farming, but warming temperatures are making it difficult to maintain the quality and yield of citrus crops. In contrast, avocados, typically sensitive to cold temperatures, are becoming a more viable option. Global warming is expected to expand areas suitable for avocado cultivation in Japan 2.5-fold or more by the middle of the century. This change is allowing farmers to adapt to the new climate conditions and explore alternative crops. As a result, Japan's avocado production is likely to increase, potentially reducing the country's reliance on imports and providing new economic opportunities for farmers. The shift is a response to the changing climate and its impact on agricultural productivity.

stories.headline: RBA hikes interest rates
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has announced an interest rate hike. This decision is expected to impact the economy, with economists and industry experts providing insights. The RBA's move is intended to address inflation and stabilize the economy. Meanwhile, other business news includes Boeing and ITB launching the BUILD Indonesia 2026 program to develop aerospace talent, and Japanese citrus farmers switching to avocados due to climate change. In the Philippines, two Lopez Holdings directors have resigned amid a family dispute, and Petronet LNG is seeking clarity on Qatar supplies for June. Additionally, gas prices may rise significantly in the next fiscal year as state-run utilities seek tariff increases. These developments reflect the complex and interconnected nature of global business and economics. The RBA's interest rate decision is a key factor in shaping Australia's economic landscape.

stories.headline: Petronet LNG sees no clarity on Qatar supply for June
stories.summary: Petronet LNG is seeking clarity on liquefied natural gas (LNG) supplies from Qatar for June. The Indian company has been affected by ongoing disruptions and a force majeure declared in May, which impacted LNG shipments. The force majeure, a clause that excuses a party from performing contractual obligations due to unforeseen events, was declared by Qatargas, the Qatari state-owned LNG producer. Petronet LNG is awaiting confirmation on whether the force majeure will be extended into June, which could further disrupt LNG supplies. The company is a major importer of LNG and relies heavily on Qatari supplies to meet India's growing energy demands. Clarity on June supplies is crucial for Petronet LNG to plan its imports and ensure a stable energy supply. The company is in talks with Qatargas to resolve the issue.

stories.headline: Gas Prices May Rise Massively Next Fiscal Year
stories.summary: State-run gas utilities are seeking significant tariff increases for the next fiscal year, which may lead to a massive rise in gas prices. The two utilities have submitted proposals to the regulator, citing increased costs and the need to reduce the allowance. The regulator is considering a gradual reduction in the allowance, which could result in higher tariffs. If approved, the tariff increases would take effect in the next fiscal year, impacting consumers and industries that rely on gas. The proposed increases are expected to be substantial, with the exact percentage yet to be determined. The regulator's decision will be crucial in determining the extent of the price hike, which could have far-reaching implications for the economy and households. The regulator is expected to make a decision soon.

stories.headline: Tech Giants Open Frontier AI Models to National Security Tests
stories.summary: Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and xAI are sharing their advanced artificial intelligence models with a government agency for national security testing. This move allows the agency to evaluate the models' potential applications and risks. Meanwhile, OpenAI's president, Greg Brockman, has disclosed that his stake in the company is worth $30 billion. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, has been involved in public discussions about the future of AI, sometimes at odds with Tesla CEO Elon Musk. However, Altman and Musk have found common ground on other issues. The sharing of AI models by tech giants marks a significant development in the collaboration between the private sector and government agencies on national security matters related to artificial intelligence. This partnership aims to ensure the responsible development and use of AI technologies.

stories.headline: OpenAI president discloses his stake in the company is worth $30B
stories.summary: Greg Brockman, OpenAI's president, disclosed in court that his stake in the artificial intelligence company is worth nearly $30 billion. Brockman, who is also the top lieutenant to CEO Sam Altman, made the revelation on Monday. The disclosure provides a rare glimpse into the ownership structure and valuation of OpenAI, a privately-held company that has been at the forefront of AI development. The company's valuation has skyrocketed in recent years, driven by the success of its AI models, including ChatGPT. Brockman's stake is a significant portion of the company's overall valuation, highlighting the enormous wealth created by OpenAI's rapid growth and innovation in the AI sector. The exact details of OpenAI's ownership and valuation remain largely private, but Brockman's disclosure sheds some light on the company's financial landscape.

stories.headline: Sam Altman may have just agreed with Elon Musk but it is not about AI but having more kids
stories.summary: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, and Elon Musk, CEO of Tesla, have found common ground on a topic unrelated to artificial intelligence. They both believe in having more children. This agreement comes despite their differing opinions on AI. Altman and Musk are prominent figures in the tech industry, with OpenAI being a leading developer of AI models. Recently, OpenAI's president, Greg Brockman, disclosed that his stake in the company is worth $30 billion. Additionally, several tech giants, including Google DeepMind and Microsoft, have agreed to share their AI models with a government agency for national security purposes. The discussion on having more children is a rare point of agreement between Altman and Musk, who often have differing views on the future of AI.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind, Microsoft and xAI have each agreed to share their frontier artificial intelligence models with a government agency for national security
stories.summary: Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and xAI have agreed to share their advanced artificial intelligence models with a government agency for national security purposes. This move involves the tech giants providing access to their frontier AI models to support national security efforts. Separately, Greg Brockman, president of OpenAI, has disclosed that his stake in the company is worth $30 billion. OpenAI's CEO, Sam Altman, has been involved in discussions about the future of artificial intelligence, sometimes at odds with Tesla CEO Elon Musk. However, Altman and Musk have found common ground on other issues, such as the importance of having more children. The sharing of AI models by Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and xAI is a significant development in the use of artificial intelligence for national security.
